problem: A qualifying durable RETURN can remain dependency-blocking when its producer closes the run with a positive but noncanonical state such as COMPLETE while dynamic readiness accepts only exact DONE. This is observed on O-SURFACE-ALUMNOS_TEACHER-REUSE-V1 and prevents the Alumnos local integration gate from becoming READY_DERIVED even though the surface return exists.
acceptance: Future universal worker runs use one canonical positive terminal state DONE for dependency-gated completion.
Existing qualifying RETURN plus non-DONE positive-terminal evidence is reconciled append-only or explicitly bounded without rewriting immutable historical evidence.
Tests cover COMPLETE + RETURN false-block regression alongside RETURN-without-DONE, DONE-without-RETURN, negative-terminal and conflicted-dependency cases.
No queue, Current, Human Accepted, Served or production promotion is performed by the repair itself.
title: Canonical worker terminal-state contract
mission: Harden universal-worker completion and dynamic-readiness integration so valid work cannot become permanently dependency-blocked because producers emit positive terminal synonyms. Preserve the strict RETURN + DONE evidence gate: fix producers/validators and add append-only reconciliation for historical noncanonical terminal runs rather than silently broadening readiness semantics.

unblock_value.reason: Removes a false terminal-state gate that currently prevents a priority-230 local integration from becoming derived-ready.

incident_repair.reason: Repairs an observed producer/consumer contract mismatch instead of weakening the evidence requirement.

regression_prevention.reason: Canonical terminal-state validation prevents future RETURN + noncanonical-terminal deadlocks across any dependency-gated surface or generated campaign.

falsification: A fixture containing the observed Alumnos Reuse qualifying RETURN plus run state COMPLETE must remain blocked before repair. After repair, no readiness consumer may silently reinterpret arbitrary positive synonyms as DONE; instead, producer validation must emit canonical DONE and historical reconciliation must add explicit append-only evidence or remain bounded. RETURN-without-DONE and DONE-without-RETURN must still block.
